(65)༄༅/ /chos drug bsdus pa'i zin bris bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (65)༄༅// chos drug bsdus pa'i zin bris bzhugs so//

(66)༄༅// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir rdo rje'i lus la rlung sems kyi rten 'brel gnad du bsnun pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang dbang med par mngon sum du byed pa/ thabs lam khyad par can gyi khrid 'chad par byed pa la/ grub thob brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa gnyis las/ dang po ni brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhin gnyis pa brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa la/ rgyud dang 'brel ba thabs lam gyi dbang du byas pa dang*/ byin rlabs dang 'brel ba snyan brgyud kyi dbang du byas pa gnyis las/ 'dir byin rlabs dang 'brel ba snyan brgyud kyi dbang du byas te bshad pa la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po sngon 'gro gzhan du gsal/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ gtum mo/ sgyu lus/ rmi lam/ 'od gsal/ bar do/ 'pho ba dang drug las/ dang po gtum mo la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ bogs 'don pa gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro la/ phyi lus kyi stong ra/ nang rtsa'i stong ra/ srung (67)ba'i 'khor lo/ rtsa lam sbyang ba/ rtsa gnas byin gyis brlab pa dang lnga las/ dang po phyi lus kyi stong ra ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor yan gyi sngon 'gro bya/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i 'od ltar dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'bar ba nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phyar bas/ rnam par rtog pa'i zug rngu ma lus pa gcod cing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pas/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba'i ros tshim par mdzad pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ thal chen spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ gru mo na yab he ru ka mtshon pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ gcer bu brgyad gnyis lon pa'i lang tsho can/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas srog bral ba'i snying ga mnan te ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/

phyi lha'i rnam pa nang stong pa'i ra ba'i ming can dwangs shing gsal bas sgrib pa med pa/ sor mo'i sbubs tshun chad stong seng nge ba/ dar dmar po'i gur ram/ (68)phru ma phus btab pa lta bu/ dang po rang gi lus tshad tsam/ da nas khang pa dang*/ ri dang*/ mthar nam mkha'i khams khyab par bsgom pa la sems zin pa/ yang je chung du song ba yungs 'bru'am/ til 'bru tsam pa skye mched shin tu gsal ba la dmigs par bya'o// gnyis pa nang rtsa'i stong ra ni/ rang rnal 'byor ma la lus tshad tsam du gsal ba'i khong pa'i dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma/ dmar ba rgya skyegs kyi khu ba/ gsal ba til gyi mar me/ drang ba chu shing gi snying po/ stong pa shog gu khong stong lta bu mtshan nyid bzhi ldan/ mda' smyug 'bring bo tsam gsal btab/ de thebs pa dang 'khar ba dang*/ ka ba dang*/ khang pa dang*/ ri tsam nas nam mkha' thams cad lus kyis khyab/ lus kyi sor mo'i mtha' tshun chad dbu mas khyab par bsgom mo/ lus yungs 'bru tsam pa'i tshe dbu ma'ang skra rtse brgyar gshags pa'i tshad tsam du phra ba bsgom mo/ de yang*/ mi gsal ba la stong ra bca'// ma zin pa la stong ra bca'// mi gnas pa la stong ra bca'/ zhes gsungs so// gsum pa srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa la/ lus gnad/ rlung gnad/ dmigs pa'i gnad gsum las/ lus gnad ni rnam snang gi chos bdun/ rlung gnad ni rlung ro lan gsum bsal nas/ steng rlung mnan/ ngag rlung yid tsam 'then pa'i kha sbyor tsam thub 'dzin pa/ dmigs pa'i gnad ni rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'od zer kha dog sna lnga pa dpag tu med pa 'thon/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'od zer sna lnga pa'i rang bzhin gyis gang*/ nang du rngub pa'i tshe bu ga thams cad nas zhugs lus thams cad gang bar bsgom pa thengs bdun/ de nas 'od zer rnams hūm̐ yig sna tshogs par gyur pas phyir 'gro ba'i tshe 'jig rten dang*/ nang du 'jug pa'i tshe lus gang bar bsam pa bdun/

de nas (69)hūm̐ de dag khro bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba/ shin tu khro zhing gtum pa/ kha dog sna lnga pa yungs 'bru tsam pa/ rlung phyir dbyung ba'i tshe 'jig rten khengs pa nang du brngubs nas 'dzin pa'i tshe lus thams cad gang bar bsgom ba bdun te nyer gcig /de nas lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad khro bo zhal phyi la gzigs pas gtams pa go gyon pa lta bu bsam mo/ bzhi pa rtsa lam sbyang ba ni/ dbu ma'i g.yas g.yon du ro rkyang gnyis klad rgya'i steng nas sna'i sgor zug pa/ mar sna gsang ba'i sna rtser zug pa/ bug pa ha re ba'i g.yon pa'i nang du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ g.yas pa'i nang du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ rnams pad+ma'i skud pa lta bur phra zhing phra ba/ kha dog dmar po brtsegs mar bsgom/ rlung phyir dbyung ba'i tshe yig 'bru re re nas phyir rgyar rgyang 'thon/ nang du 'jug pa'i tshe gsang ba'i sna rtse nas zhugs pa mgal me 'khor ba lta bu la sems 'dzin cing rlung kha sbyor du bsgom mo/ de ni chu 'dren pa'i sngon du yur ba gad byed pa dang 'dra ste shin tu gnad che'o// lnga pa rtsa gnas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dbus kyi rtsa dbu ma gro sogs 'bring bo'i sbubs tsam pa'i snying ga'i nang du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de'i dbu thog tu chos drug brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa/ mu tig gi 'phreng ba bsgrigs pa lta bur shin tu phra ba bsgoms te/ chos drug gsol 'debs sam/ yang na/ snang ba gtum mor 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ snang ba sgyu mar= snang ba 'od gsal du= snang ba sku gsum du= gong nas gong du (70)'pho bar= mchog gi dngos grub thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ de zag pa med pa bde ba'i rang bzhin du zhu bas lus thams cad gang bar bsam mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ las kyi gtum mo/ nyams kyi gtum mo/ mchog gi gtum mo gsum las/ dang po las kyi gtum mo la/ bca' ba lus kyi gnad/ zhi drag rlung gi gnad/ bsgom pa dmigs pa'i gnad gsum las/ dang po bca' ba lus kyi gnad ni/ gzhung du/ lus ni rdo rje skyil mo krung*// sgal tshig rin chen rtsar la brgyus// mthong kha rgyun du yangs pa dang*// ltong sko shin tu sba bar bya// lce ni yar rkan nyid du gtad// mnyam gzhag phyag rgya lte 'og btsir// mig dang shes pa ma 'gyur bar// rlung sems dril la drag tu gcun// rdo rje skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas// yang na lus ni tsog pur bsdad// re'u mig bzhin bsnol bar bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i don/ rkang pa g.yas steng du bton pa'i rdo rje skyil krung*/ mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya lte 'og tu bcas pa'i gru mos stod gcun/ sgal tshigs dor rtse brtsegs pa ltar bsrang*/ mthong kha yangs par bya/ og skos o la mdud mnan/ lce yar rkan la gtad pa'i mig gnyis sna rtse'am/ thad ka'i bar snang la blta'o// yang na gzhan sngar bzhin la/ lus tsog pu re'u mig bzhin bsnol ba/ sgom thag khug pas mgo bo 'khor ba tshad de/ des lham sgrog 'chings nas lus bsdam/ tshangs ra'i gdan du 'bebs gdan khru gang*/ dpangs su sor bzhi yod pa nang tshangs can bya'o// gnyis pa zhi drag rlung gi gnad la/ 'jam rlung dang drag rlung gnyis las/ dang po 'jam rlung la/ sngon 'gro 'bud pa dgu phrugs/ (71)dngos gzhi sbyor ba bzhi ldan gnyis las/ dang po sngon 'gro 'bud ba dgu phrugs ni/ g.yas nas g.yon/ g.yon nas g.yas/ dbus nas thad kar gtad nas 'jam po mis mi tshor ba gsum/ drag po gsum/ gcud cing 'bud pa gsum ste dgu phrugs su bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi sbyor ba bzhi ldan ni/

lcags kyu bzhin tu dgug par bya// bum pa bzhin du dgang ba dang*// rgya mdud bzhin du bsdams nas su// mda' ltar gyen du 'phang bar bya/ zhes sam/ brngub dang dgang dang gzhil ba dang*// 'phang bar bya dang rnam pa bzhi// sbyor ba bzhi ldan ma shes na// yon tan skyon du 'gyur ba'i nyan/ zhes pa'i don phyi'i sor bcu drug tsam gyi thad nas sgra med du sna gnyis kyi nang du gzhug pa brngub pa de lte 'og tu mnan/ 'og rlung cung zad 'then nas kha sbyor du 'dzin pa dgang ba/ mi thub la khad pa dang brngub chung bya/ g.yas bcag g.yon bcag cha mnyam du bcag pa gzhil pa/ de nas mi thub la khad pa dang sna gnyis nas/ dang po dang mjug tu shed chung zhing*/ bar du shugs che bar dbyung ba mda' ltar 'phang pa'o/// gnyis pa drag rlung ni/ rlung log mi 'byung ba 'bud pa'i gnad/ rlung rang gnas su gzhug la brngub pa'i gnad/ rlung dbang du 'du ba dgang ba'i gnad/ rlung rtsa mig tu gdab pa gzhil ba'i gnad/ rlung phyi nang bsre ba gtong ba'i gnad do/// gsum pa sgom pa dmigs pa'i gnad la/ phyi'i gtum mo/ nang gi gtum mo/ gsang ba'i gtum mo gsum las/ dang po phyi'i gtum mo ni/ skad cig tsam gyis yi dam lha// sgyu ma lta bu'i sku bsgoms te/ zhes gong bzhin rnal 'byor ma'i stong ra lus tshad tsam gsal btab/ gnyis (72)pa nang gi gtum mo ni// gdung dang shing rta ltar gnas pa'i// 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas pa bsgom/ zhes pas/ lus stong ra'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma ngo bo chos nyid mtshon pas stong pa/ kha dog bde ba mtshon pas dmar ba/ byed las sgrib pa dag pas gsal ba/ mtshan nyid srog shing mtshon pas drang ba ste mtshan nyid bzhi ldan/ tshangs bug nas lte 'og sor bzhir zug pa'i sna gnyis bcad khar yod pa/ g.yas g.yon du ro rkyang gnyis lug rgyud kyi rgyu ma lta bu glad rgya'i steng nas mdun du 'khyogs shing sna'i sgor zug pa/ mar sna dbu ma'i nang du chud pas yi ge cha'i 'phongs lta bu/

rtsa gsum 'dus mtshams spyi bor rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis kha 'og tu lta ba/ mgrin par bcu drug yar lta ba/ snying gar brgyad mar lta ba/ lte bar drug cu rtsa bzhi yar lta bas gdugs kyi rtsib ma lta bu'am/ shing rta'i 'khor lo dang rgyud rim bzhin du bsgom mo// gsum pa gsang ba'i gtum mo ni/ gtum mo a thung yul gyi gnad/ ces pa lte 'og sor bzhi'i dbu ma'i nang ro rkyang gnyis 'dzom pa'i rtse mor/ a thung shad blu ta'i rnam pa can sor phyed pa/ kha dog dmar ser/ reg bya tsha ba/ spu rtse rlung gis bskyod pa lta bur bskyod pa myur ba pheṃ pheṃ gyi sgra sgrog pa dang*/ spyi bo'i dbu ma'i nang du haṃ yig dkar po bdud rtsi 'dzag la khad pa gsal btab nas/ rlung brngubs pa ro brkyang gi lam du song*/ de gnyis phus btab pa ltar gang nas dbu ma'i nang du zhugs/ a shad la phog bas dmar ltem gyis song*/ dgang ba dang gzhil ba'i tshe kho na la sems rtse gcig tu bzhag /dbyung ba'i dus rlung dbu ma'i nang nas sngo 'phyur don par bsams nas/ dngos su sna nas 'bud do/ de la sems rtse gcig pa thob nas/ de nas tshul 'dra ba'i rlung thobs gnyis pa la/ a shad las (73)so sor phyad pa rtse mo shin tu rno ba 'bar bas/ mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du gyur ba 'phang thur lta bur bsam/ rlung de 'dra ba re res me sor phyed phyed sbar bas brgyad kyis lte bar sleb/ rlung khug pa bcus lte ba'i rtsa 'dabs mes gang*/ yang bcus lto ba nas mar song rkang sor gyi rtse'i bar mes gang*/ de nas bcus yar 'bar bas snying ga man gang*/ bcus mgrin pa dang*/ bcus spyi bo gang ba 'bar ba la dmigs nas/ nam mkha'i ba ni rim bzhin bzho/ zhes pa bcus spyi bo'i haṃ yig mes chil gyis bzhu bas byang chub sems kyis spyi bo gang*/ bcus mgrin pa gang*/ bcus snying ga bcus lte ba/ bcus sor mo'i mtha' tshun chad gang ba 'dzag pa la bslab pa ste rlung khug brgya dang brgyad la thun gcig tu byas pa/

dang po nyin zhag re la thun drug dang phyis nas thun bzhi la sogs pa rlung thag ring thung la ltos nas bya ste/ zas dang khams gso'i gnyid ma gtogs pa bar med du bsgom mo/ de ni lus sems rlung gsum gyi las la gnad du bsnun pa'i phyir las kyi gtum mo zhes bya'o// gnyis pa nyams kyi gtum mo la/ thun mong dang khyad par gyi nyams gnyis las/ dang po thun mong gi nyams ni/ rlung ni zin par gyur pa na// dang po drod lta bu 'byung*// gnyis pa bde ba 'char ba dang*// gsum pa mi rtog skye bar 'gyur// de nas rnam rtog shugs kyis 'gag /du ba smig rgyu me khyer dang*// skya rengs shar ba ji bzhin dang*// nam mkha' sprin dag lta bu 'byung*/ zhes pa'i don/ rlung phyir 'phro ba rtsol bas bkag pa rang gnas su gnas pa ni zin pa zhes bya ste/ de'i dbang gis rlung rgyu ba'i grangs nyung du song ba rgyu ba zin pa/ phyir song tshad thung du song ba ring thung zin pa/ phyir rgyu ba'i shad nyams pa shugs zin pa/ de nas kha dog shes pa kha dog zin pa/ (74)de nas 'byung ba so so'i nus pa thim pa stobs zin pa ste/ de ltar rlung zin pas gtum mo'i rba rlabs brtan/ de nas rlung sems rnal du tshud pa'i drod skye/ des rtsa kha bye ba rnams su rlung gis thig le khrid de phyin pas rtsa zug dang*/ thig le'i zug dang*/ rigs drug gi gnas sbyong shar ba 'dus pa dang po sdug bsngal gyi dus sam/ drod kyi dus zhes bya'o// de nas rtsa rgud pa rlung dang khams kyis gsos pas byang chub kyi sems 'phel zhing smin nas thag pa dang bcas pa'i bde ba mtha' yas pa rnyed pa ni gnyis pa bde ba'i dus so// de nas nang gi bde ba la sems chags pas phyi rol gyi dngos po la dga' ba nyams/ rgyu des rnam rtog rgyun chags kyi dug zhi nas sems rnal du phebs pa rnam par mi rtog pa zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin shar zhing*/

de la goms pa gsum pa mi rtog pa'i dus so// de lta bu'i zhi gnas de'ang tshor ba btang snyoms kyi mtshan nyid can ma yin te/ du ba dang*/ smig rgyu dang*/ me khyer dang*/ sgron ma'am skya rengs dang*/ sprin med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu la sogs pa'i nyams kyi snang ba bgrang du med pas lhag par gsal ba'i phyir ro// rnal 'byor pas khams 'dus pa gsum po de gang gi gnas skabs su'ang rtags mtshan yod pa mi spangs/ med pa mi bsgrub par byung rgyal du las kyi gtum mo bskyangs pas rlung las su rung bar gyur te phyi rol gyi nad dang rgas pa la sogs pa'i rkyen gang gis kyang gnod mi nus shing*/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i mngon shes lnga la sogs pa yon tan mtha' yas pa 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa khyad par gyi nyams ni// de yi rkyen gyis dhū tī ru// rlung rnams tshud par gyur ba yis/ ces dang*/ khyad par rtags lnga yon tan brgyad/ ces pa thun mong gi dus su 'bab 'bun 'ded gyis rlung dbu mar zhugs pa/ srog rtsol (75)gyis rlung dbu mar tshud pa zhes bya ba/ 'dir ni rnal 'byor gyi stobs kyis dbu mar tshud pa zhes bya ba phyi nang gi rlung gcig tu 'dres pa srog thur gong bu gcig tu gyur nas/ lus kyi lte ba gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo nas dbu mar zhugs shing 'khor lo bzhi'i lte ba nas lte ba 'ba' zhig tu 'gro 'ong byas pas gtum mo ye shes kyi me stobs su gyur nas byang chub kyi sems thams cad du 'dus pas mdud pa lhod par gyur pa de'i dbang gis khyad par gyi rtags lnga/ 'bar ba dang*/ zla ba dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ skra gcan dang*/ go gces bya ba dang*/ 'od zer ser/ dkar/ dmar/ sngo/ dmar skya lnga'i dbus su lus chung ba dang*/ yon tan brgyad kyi rtogs pa mngon du 'gyur te/ de yang*/ sa'i yon tan sred med kyi bu'i stobs dang*/ chu'i yon tan mnyan lcug dang*/ mes mi 'tshig /me'i yon tan dngos po thams cad 'byin sdud nus shing*/

chur mi bying*/ rlung gi yon tan rkang mgyogs dang lus shing bal lta bur yang ba/ nam mkha'i yon tan 'phur ba dang*/ sa dang chu la sogs pa thams cad la thogs pa med pa/ zla ba'i yon tan lus shel ltar dwangs nas grib ma mi 'byung*/ nyi ma'i yon tan lus snyigs ma dag pa'i 'ja' lus su gyur pas gzhan gyis mi mthong*/ thams cad kun tu son pa'i yon tan sku'i sgo dgu 'gag /gsung gi sgo bzhi 'gag /thugs kyi sgo gnyis bye bas bde ba chen po nang nas 'char zhing de'i dbang gis rnam pa thams cad pa'i thod brgal gyi ting nge 'dzin khor mo yug tu 'char ba yin no// gsum pa mchog gi gtum mo ni/ ma bcos gnyug ma lhan cig skyes// zag pa med pa'i ting 'dzin gnas// zhes pas/ g.yon phung po lnga'i rlung de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ g.yas khams lnga'i (76)rlung de bzhin gshegs ma'i rang bzhin dbu ma'i nang du mas rim gyis thim pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen po rnam pa thams cad pa'i mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i gnyug ma sems kyi gnas lugs rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon sum du rtogs pas/ lte ba/ snying ga /mgrin pa/ spyi bo rnams su rgyu mthun dang*/ rnam smin dang*/ skyes bu byed pa dang*/ bral ba'i 'bras bu'i tshul bzhis byang chub kyi sems gyen du gshegs pas dbu ma'i yar sna rengs nas/ gtsug tor pa ltar mi mngon pa 'grub/ de byang chub kyis sems kyis gang ba'i tshe phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob pa yin no// khams dkar po gsad ba'i sna rtse nas gyen du rengs nas gtsug tor gyi mthar thug par gang ba dang*/ dmar po gtsug tor nas rengs te rkang pa'i mthe bong gi mthar thug pa gang ba lhan cig tu 'byung ba yin no/ gsum pa bogs 'don la/ drod kyi bogs 'don dang*/ bde ba'i bogs 'don gnyis las/

dang po drod kyi bogs 'don la/ lus gnad/ rlung gnad/ dmigs pa'i gnad las/ lus gnad ni/ tsog pur rkang pa bsnol ba'i rgyu ma khung gnyis lag pa ring na bsnol/ thung na rang dgar 'khyud/ pho ba g.yas g.yon du sgril ba gsum gsum dang*/ de nas thub tshad du gtsub/ mthar rta rgod sprugs pa ltar drag tu si li li sprug pa dang bstun rdeb chung gcig byed/ de 'dra ba gsum gyi mthar tshig rdzogs kyi rdeb chen re bya'o// rlung gnad ni steng mnan/ 'og bsdam pa'i bum pa can no// dmigs pa'i gnad ni rang nyid rnal 'byor ma'i stong ra rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi a shad dang bcas pa gsal btab pa'i/ 'og gi lag pa dang rkang pa'i (77)mthil gnyis su nyi ma re re ste kha sbyar/ sum mdor nyi ma/ rkang lag gi nyi ma bsrubs pas me 'bar/ lte 'og gi nyi ma la phog /de las me 'bar a shad la phog /de las me 'bar lus thams cad gang*/ rlung phyir gtong ba'i tshe 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad me'i rang bzhin du 'bar bar bsgom mo/ rdeb chen nyer gcig la thun gcig tu byas nas/ zhag bdun du bsgoms na ras thub par mtshom med do// gnyis pa bde ba'i bogs 'don la/ sngon 'gro yid rig /dngos gzhi 'bar 'dzag /rjes bca' ba lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ro// sngon 'gro yid rig ni/ mdun du yid kyi rig ma mi'i bu mo mtshan dang ldan pa sems chags su rung ba zhig bsgom mo/ dngos gzhi 'bar 'dzag la/ zus gnad me thab drug chings/ rlung gnad sbyor ba bzhi ldan/ dmigs pa'i gnad/ rang nyid 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i stong ra dar sngon po'i gur phub pa lta bu'i lus kyi nang du rtsa gsum 'bor lo bzhi/ a shad haṃ yig dang bcas gong bzhin gsal btab/ rlung gis a shad las me sbar/ de'i drod kyis haṃ yig zhu ba'i thigs pa lhung*/ a shad la phog tshegs sgra dang bcas pas me lce mar thur du song*/ slar snga ma las cher 'bar bas lte bar sleb/

haṃ yig cher zhu ba'i thigs pa phog pas mar bros/ des cher gsos/ me lce snying gar sleb/ tshul des mgrin pa dang spyi bor phyin pas haṃ yig chil gyis bzhu ba'i rgyun mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor gang bar babs pas dga' ba'i bde ba dang*/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i skad cig ma dang*/ stong pa'i ngang du mnyam par gzhag /de nas snying ga gang ba mchog dga' dang*/ rnam par smin pa dang*/ shin tu stong pa/ lte bas khyad dga' dang*/ rnam par nyed pa dang*/ stong pa chen po/ gsang ba'i sna (78)rtse'i mthar thug par babs pas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba/ mtshan nyid dang bral ba'i skad cig thams cad stong pa/ 'od gsal ngos bzung nas/ 'dzag med du bzung bas lte ba snying ga mgrin pa spyi bo gang ba dga' ba nas lhan skyes kyi bar ngos gzung bar bya'o// rjes bca' ba lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni/ rtsa ba'i 'khrul 'khor nā ro drug skor dang*/ nyi shu pa dang*/ lnga bcu pa la sogs pa bya'o// gnyis pa sgyu lus la/ ma dag pa'i sgyu lus rgyu mar sbyang ba/ dag pa'i sgyu lus sgyu mar sbyang ba/ gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad sgyu mar sbyang ba gsum las/ dang po ma dag pa'i sgyu lus sgyu mar sbyang ba ni/ rnam par smin pa'i sgyu lus dang*/ zhes pa/ rang gi mdun du shing bu la me long btags pa la'am/ gang yang rung ba la gzugs 'char du bcug nas/ de la rnyed pa sbyin pa dang*/ grags pa dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ bde bas dga' ba dang*/ 'phrogs pa dang*/ mi snyan pa dang*/ smad pa dang*/ sdug bsngal bas mi dga' ba mi 'byung ba bzhin du// rang dang me long gi bar du gzugs brnyan de 'dra ba bsgoms la sbyar/ de nas rang nyid me long gi gzugs brnyan dang khyad par med par bltas te thams cad la dpe bcu drug gis sgyu ma lta bur blo sbyong zhing do gal du 'dzin pa spang bar bya'o// gnyis pa dag pa'i sgyu lus sgyu mar sbyang bas/ bskyed rim sgyu ma dang*/ rdzogs rim sgyu ma gnyis las/

dang po bskyed rim sgyu ma ni/ gsang ba'i dbang gi dus dag tu// mi long dri ma med pa la// rdo rje sems dpa' legs bris te// de yi gzugs brnyan snang dang mtshungs/ zhes pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'am/ yi dam gyi lha gang yang rung ba'i bris sku 'gying log me long du 'char du bcug la/ de'i gzugs brnyan la mig dang shes pa ma 'gyur bar (79)bltas nas de ji lta ba yid yul du bsgoms pas 'char pa dang*/ me long dang rang gi bar du bsgom/ de nas rang me long nang gi lha'i gzugs de ji lta bar bsgoms pas/ reg tu rung ba tsam du 'char na/ gang mthong ba'i gzugs gcig de lta bu'i lha'i skur bsgom/ de gsal na gang mthong ba'i gzugs thams cad yi dam gyi lha de lta bur gsal btab pas/ snang ba thams cad lha'i rol par 'char ba lha'i de kho na nyid ces bya ste/ bskyed rim sgyu ma dang*/ chos can lha dang lha mor dag pa zhes bya'o// gnyis pa rdzogs rim sgyu ma ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu de ste/ dngos grub nges 'jug nye ba yin/ zhes pa lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun/ sems 'das pa'i rjes mi dpyad/ ma 'ongs pa'i sngun mi bsu/ da lta bar bzo ma byas par ma yengs pas bar snang stong seng nge ba la rtse gcig tu bltas pas/ rlung sems dbu mar tshud/ rnam par rtog pa zhi nas/ du ba la sogs pa'i rtags lnga/ khyad par sprin med pa'i nam mkha' la sangs rgyas kyi sku'i snang ba chu'i zla ba'am/ me long la gzugs shar ba ltar dwangs shing gsal la sgrib pa med pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa'i sprul pa'i sku mthong zhing*/ de nas sgrar snang ba'i longs sku 'byung ngo// de yang ār+ya de bas/ chos kun rmi lam sgyu 'dra zhes/ sangs rgyas pa kun smra mod kyi// bdag byin rlabs las phyir phyogs pas// rmi lam sgyu 'dra mthong ba med/ ces gsungs so// gsum pa gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad sgyu mar sbyang ba ni/

khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu ba// ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ ces pa mnyam gzhag de brtan pa dang*/ rjes shes kyi snang ba'i steng du stong gzugs drangs nas bltas pas/ 'khor 'das la sogs pa'i gnyis su snang ba'i chos thams cad (80)gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kun rdzob kyi bden pa sgyu ma'i ting nge 'dzin du 'char zhing*/ de nyid la mnyam par bzhag pas 'od gsal du dag par 'gyur ro// gsum pa rmi lam la/ gzung ba/ sbyang ba/ sgyu mar bslab pa/ rmi lam gyi de kho na nyid bsgom pa bzhi las/ dang po gzung ba la/ 'dun pa'i stobs kyis gzung ba/ rlung gis stobs kyis gzung ba/ dmigs pa'i stobs kyis gzung ba gsum las/ dang po 'dun pa'i stobs kyis 'dzin pa ni/ dang por rmi lam gzung ba dang*/ zhes pa dran pa rgyun chag 'dun pa rjes 'brang du byed pa ste/ de'ang nyin par gyi gnas skabs thams cad du'ang*/ rmi lam yin spyad dgos snyam pa'i dran pa dang*/ nub mo nyal khar bla ma la rmi lam zin pa'i gsol ba btab/ rmi lam zin par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa yid la drag po bsgoms pas nges par zin te/ chos rnams thams cad rkyen yin te/ 'dun pa'i rtsa la rab tu gnas/ zhes so// gnyis pa rlung gi stobs kyis 'dzin pa ni/ gzhogs g.yas 'og tu phab/ seng ge'i 'dug stangs kyis nyal/ lag g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis mgrin pa'i rtsa 'phar ba mnan/ mdzub mos sna dam por bkag mchil ma mgrin par bskyil lo// gsum pa dmigs pa'i stobs kyis 'dzin pa la/ dngos/ spogs chog/ 'byams gcod pa las/ dngos ni/ rang nyid lhar bltas pa'i mgrin pa'i dbus su gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo āḥyig dmar po gsal btab/ de'i 'od kyis snang ba thams cad me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sgyu mar bsgoms pas zin par 'gyur ro// spogs chog ni/ srod la kha rtsang gi dmigs pa de kas 'dzin/ tho rangs rlung bum pa can bdun/

rmi lam zin par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa thengs bcu (81)gcig /dmigs pa smin mtshams su rus pa'i thig le dkar po la sems gtad do// khrag shas che na dmar po dang*/ rlung shas che na ljang khur bsgom/ des ma zin na/ srod la de ka bsgom/ tho rangs rlung nyi shu rtsa gcig /'dun pa'ang nyer gcig /dmigs pa gsang ba'i sna rtser thig le nag po ril ma tsam la shes pa gtad pas zin par 'gyur ro// 'byams gcad pa ni/ sad 'byams ni/ rmi lam zin kyang spyad dgos bsam pa dang 'phral du sad pa'o// de la zas bcud can bsten/ lus ngal dub kyi las byas pas gnyid che bar 'gyur ro// des sel lo// dred 'byams ni/ sngar gyi rmi lam yong bzhin pa zhig gtan du rmis nas 'gyur du ma 'dod pa ste/ de la yang yang du rmi ba de bsgom/ da rmi lam sbyang bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa la 'bad/ smin mtshams kyi thig le dang rlung sbyor ro// rdugs 'byams ni/ rmi lam mang po rmis pa la ye dran pas ma zin pa dang*/ grib dang mi gtsang ba la 'dzem/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blang*/ gsang gnas kyi thig le la dmigs pa des sel lo// stong 'byams ni/ rmi lam rmi ru ye ma 'dod pa ste/ de la gsang gnas kyi thig le la dmigs pa dang rlung bsgom/ khyad par tshogs gtor gyis dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnyes par bya'o// gnyis pa sbyang ba ni/ de nas sbyang zhing zhes pa/ rmi lam du me lta bu rmi na/ rmi lam gyi me la 'jigs su ci yod snyam nas de'i steng du mchong pa sogs/ gang rmi ba la thog brdzis gtang zhing*/ de la goms nas zhing khams sna tshogs pa blta bar bya'o// de la nyal khar mgrin pa'i dbus su thig le dmar po'i nang du gang blta 'dod ba'i zhing khams de'i yon tan thams cad gsal bar shar bar mos te sems bzung bas/ dga' ldan nam/ bde ba can/ (82)mngon par dga' ba la sogs pa gang 'dod pa'i zhing khams mthong ba 'byongs pa'i tshad do// gsum pa sgyu mar bslab pa ni/

sgyu mar bslab pa/ de tshe yang spang ba dang*/ zhes pas/ ma rmi na chur sprul pa go zlog gi gnyen po dang*/ chung du rmi na chen por sprul/ chen po chung ngur bsgyur ba stobs che chung dang*/ gcig rmi na mang por bsgyur/ mang po gcig tu sdud ba la goms na/ rmi lam du rang gi lus dang gang mthong thams cad lha'i sku sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms pa de ltar du shar ba yin no// bzhi pa de kho na nyid bsgom pa ni/ kho na nyid don bsgom pa'o// zhes pas/ rmi lam gyi snang ba gang mthong ltar mthong nas rmi lam gyi bag chags dag /lha'i sku la sems bzung nas ma bcos par mnyam par gzhag pas lha'i snang ba de nyid dmigs pa med pa'i ngang du zhi nas thams cad stong pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi 'od gsal 'char/ de la goms par gyur na gnyid log pa dang*/ sad pa khyad par med pa snang pa thams cad 'od gsal du 'char bas snang sems 'dres par 'gyur ro// bzhi pa 'od gsal la/ gzhi'i 'od gsal/ lam gyi 'od gsal/ 'bras bu'i 'od gsal gsum las/ dang po gzhi'i 'od gsal ni/ 'od gsal ngos 'dzin man ngag 'dir// gzhi lam 'bras bur rang shes bya/ zhes pas/ yul dmigs pa med pa'i bde ba chen po/ yul can rnam pa thams cad pa'i mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid dang dbyer mi phyed pa chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid sems dngos po'i gnas lugs de la rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal zhes bya'o// gnyis pa lam gyi 'od gsal la nyin mo lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu bsre ba/ mtshan mo lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu bsre ba/ bar do lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu bsre ba gsum las/ dang po nyin mo lam dang rang (83)bzhin gcig tu bsre ba ni/ de nyid rig la gang gis gnas// ye shes gsum ni rnam dag des// mngon par byang chub shes par 'gyur/ zhes pa chos lnga ste/ sngon du gang 'gro na bla ma 'gro/ dpe bu chung ma'i mngal nas skyes ma thag pas mtshon/ mtshams gang gis sbyor na snang mched thob gsum gyis sbyor/

des rtog pa snga ma 'gags phyi ma ma skyes pa'i bar du 'dzin/ lam du ti l+li pa'i chos drug gis slod ste/ de yang*/ mi mno mi bsam mi dpyad cing*/ mi bsgom mi sems rang babs gzhag /de ltar bsgoms pas gang snang stong nyid du shar ba 'od gsal lta bu/ rtog pas phyi'i so mtshams su sems kyi gnas lugs sgrib med du shar ba 'od gsal ma/ de ngo shes pa 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa'am/ lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu 'dres pa zhes bya'o// gnyis pa mtshan mo lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu bsre ba ni/ snying gi pad+mo kha phye ste/ 'dab bzhi dbus kyi lte ba la// a nu ta ra hūm̐ bsgoms nas/

zhes sam/ phung po lam dang skye mched dbang sogs la/ shes pa gnyis pos deng 'dir rab bsdus nas// stong chen gyur pa gang zhig gnyid log pa// rlung gi shugs kyis rmi lam mthong bar 'gyur/ zhes pas/ sngon du gnyid mthug po 'gro/ dpe rgya mtsho rlabs kyis ma bskyod pas mtshon/ mtshams gnyid du 'gro ba'i snang mched thob gsum gyis sbyor/ ngos nyin par gyi rtog pa 'gags rmi lam gyi snang ba ma byung ba'i bar du 'dzin/ lam du bsam gtan gnyid dang bsre ba'i gdam ngag gis slong ste/ de'ang bla ma la 'od gsal zin pa'i gsol ba btab/ 'dun pa drag po gtang*/ nyal dus gzhogs g.yas 'og tu phab/ seng ge'i 'dug stangs bzhin nyal/ lus lhar bsgoms pa'i snying pad+ma 'dab ma bzhir gyes pa'i dbus su (84)hūm̐/ mdun du a/ g.yas su nu/ rgyab tu ta/ g.yon du ra gsal btab/ gnyid du thim thim 'gro ba'i tshe snang grags thams cad rang la thim/ de pad+ma 'dab bzhi la/ de nas gnyid kyis cher bzi pa'i tshe mdun gyi a la thim/ de g.yas kyi nu/ de ta/ de ra la/ de hūm̐/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu ha/ de zla tshes/ de thig le/ de nā da/ de mi dmigs pas 'od gsal la gnas par bsams nas nyal ba rjes gzhig gi rnal 'byor/ yang na a nu ta ra bzhi lam me ba'i dbus kyi hūm̐ yig 'ba' zhig la sems gtad pa ril 'dzin no// de ltar gnyid ma log pa'i gnas skabs snang ba/ gnyid kyis bzi ba mched pa/ gnyid du song ba thob pa/ de nas gnyid 'thug po'i 'od gsal 'char ba 'od gsal ma/ thim rim la dmigs rten bcas sems ma bcos par gzhag pas thim rim stong par shar ba bu dpe sngar 'dris kyi ma dang 'phrad pa bzhin gzhi'i 'od gsal ngo shes pa 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa zhes bya'o// gsum pa bar dor bshad/ gsum pa 'bras bu'i 'od gsal ni/ 'od gsal las shes bzhin du dag pa'i sgyu lus chu las nya ldang ba'am/ gnyid log pa las sad pa lta bur bzhengs pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa ni sbyong gzhi sbyong byed yod pa slob pa'i zung 'jug ste/

sa rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa sa bcu gnyis yin la/ gzugs phra reg na yang ba dang*/ khyab dang yang dag thob pa dang*/ rab tu snang dang brtan pa dang*/ dbang sgyur 'dod dgur sgyur ba ste/ dbang phyug brgyad ces de la bshad/ ces so/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed zad pa ni mi slob pa 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'chang chen po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ sku dang gsung gi dbang phyug dang*// thugs dang rdzu 'phrul kun 'gro gnas// ci 'dod skyed dang yon tan brgyan// 'di ni 'bras bu'i dbang phyug brgyad/ ces so// lnga pa bar (85)do la/ bar do dang po 'od gsal chos sku'i lam khyer/ gnyis pa zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs sku'i lam khyer/ gsum pa skye ba 'dzin pa sprul sku'i lam khyer dang gsum las/ bar do dang po 'od gsal chos sku'i lam khyer ni/ snang ba thim dang rags pa thim// rtog pa thim dang phra ba thim// thim pa'i rjes su goms pa dang*// rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal 'char// de yi rjes la zung 'jug gi /sku ni rnam pa gnyis 'byung ste// slob pa dang ni mi slob gnyis// mi slob pa ru gyur tsa na// 'bras bu thob ces bstan pa yin/ zhes pa sngon du 'chi ba 'gro /dpe ston gnam dri ma med pas mtshon/ mtshams 'chi ka'i snang mched thob gsum gyis sbyor/ ngos tshe 'di'i rtog pa 'gags phyi ma'i rtog pa ma shar bar der 'dzin/ lam du lam dang rang bzhin gcig tu byed pa'i gdam ngag gis slong ste/ de yang*/ mig sogs dbang po lnga'i rlung nang du thim pas gzugs kyi snang ba nub pa/ snang ba thim pa/ de nas sa chu la thim/ lus kyi zungs shor/ chu me la thim/ skom zhing kha sna bskams/ me rlung la thim/ drod yal/ rlung rnam shes la thim/ de'i tshe sdig can la gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal 'byung*/ dge ba spyod pa la/ lha dang bla ma ḍā ki'i bsun ma 'ong*/ de nas phyi dbugs chad pa/ rags pa thim pa/ de nas nang dbugs gnas pa'i dang por/

rtog pa thim pa'i rim pa phyi'i rtags zla ba shar ba lta bu/ nang rtags du ba/ snang ba'i skabs/ de mched pa la thim/ zhe sdang gi rtog pa so gsum 'gag /phyi rtags nyi ma shar ba lta bu/ nang rtags me khyer/ mched pa'i skabs/ de snang ba nyer thob la thim/ 'dod chags kyi rtog pa bzhi bcu 'gag /phyi rtags nag lam sgra gcan gyi snang ba/ nang rtags bum nang gi mar me lta bu/ (86)snang ba nyer thob/ de 'od gsal la thim/ gti mug gi rtog pa bdun 'gag /phra ba thim pa/ phyi rtags skya rengs shar ba lta bu/ nang rtags ston gnam dri ma med pa lta bu/ bzhi pa 'od gsal gyi skabs/ 'chi srid kyi dngos gzhi/ bar do mgo rtsom pa'i thog ma yin pas/ gdams ngag pa rnams kyis bar do dang po zhes bya'o// nyams len ni/ 'chi kar chags snang gi 'khri ba bcad/ thim rim gyi steng du ma bcos par glod pas thim rim shar grol du song ba 'od gsal bu de'i rkyen gyis bzhi pa 'od gsal shar ba ma/ de sngar 'dris kyi mi dang 'phrad pa lta bur rig pa 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa zhes bya ste/ 'od gsal de la nam 'dod du gnas nas/ de nas lugs bzlog gi snang ba gsum gyis zung 'jug gi skur langs spyi bo nas 'pho ba ni/ sbyangs pa can sangs rgyas kyis dang*/ sbyangs pa cung zad man pas bcu ci rigs pa'i rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs sku'i lam khyer ni/ stong pa chen po/ de nas 'dod chags gyi rtog pa bzhi bcu langs/ mched pa shar/ shin tu stong pa/ de nas zhe sdang gi rtog pa so gsum langs/ snang ba shar/ stong pa zhes bya/ de nas khyab byed kyi rlung gis 'du byas te rnam par shes pa sngar gyi phung po rnying pa'i sgo dgu gang rung gi lam las 'phos nas bar do'i srid par grub bo// de yang gang du skye 'gyur gyi srid pa de'i sha tshugs kyi yid lus dbang po kun tshang ba/ ma'i mngal ma gtogs gang la'ang mi thogs pa/

bsam pa tsam gyis stong gsum bgrod pa'i las kyi rdzu 'phrul can/ bar do nang rigs mthun pas mthong*/ lha'i mig gis mthong*/ zas su dri zab/ nyi zla mi snang bas/ snang ba'ang min/ mun pa'ang ma yin pas/ snang mun 'od kyi (87)bar do/ de yang phyed dang bzhi'i zhag tshun brgyal thabs su gnas/ de nas shi bar ngo shes pas shin tu mya ngan che ba zhig 'byung*/ de'i dus bar do la bar dor ngo shes pa yod/ de'i sngon la brgyal/ phyi nas 'khrul snang shas che ba'i phyir/ dus de kho nar bar do'i gdams ngag dran dgos pas dus kyis zhes bya'o// lam khyer ni/ de la srid pa'i bar ma dor/ sgyu lus zung 'jug skur gyur te/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'thob bo// zhes pas/ shi bar ngo shes pa dang*/ rang lus lhar bsgom/ de nas rjes gzhig gam/ ril 'dzin dran pas 'od gsal du chug /de nas lugs bzlog gi snang ba gsum rgyur byas pa'i 'bras bu zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang du bzhengs pa'i sangs rgyas yin no// gsum pa skye ba 'dzin pa sprul sku'i lam khyer ni/ bar do gnyis par lam mchod na 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi zhes pa sa rlung las ri nyil ba lta bu'i sgra/ chu rlung las rgya mtsho rlabs 'chos pa'i sgra/ me rlung las nags la me mched pa'i sgra/ rlung gi rlung las 'brug stong dus gcig tu ldir ba lta bu'i sgra 'byung*/ de la zhed nas bros pas gang du tshud pa de mngal yin/ nyam nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum ni/ dkar dmar nag po'i gcong g.yang de gang rung la lhung ba de mngal/ rnam byang gi lam dkar po la sogs pa 'od lnga'i lam/ der phyin pas mngal du chud/ gzhan yang thig le thig phran 'char ba char drag pos 'ded pa/ khro bo khro mos 'jigs sngangs ston pa la sogs pa 'byung*/ srog gcod pa'i gshed mas khrid pa dang*/ lcags khang du tshud pa dmyal ba/ sdong dum dang sa skyibs su yibs pa yi dwags dang dud 'gro/ ngang pas brgyad pa'i mtshor bying ba shar gling*/

ba glang gis brgyan pa nub gling*/ rtas brgyan pa byang gling du skye/ khang (88)bzang pha ma'i 'du 'phrod mthong ba lho 'dzam bu gling*/ lha'i gzhal med khang mthong nas nang du tshud pa ltar skye ba'i mtshan ma/ 'khrul pa'i snang ba shas che bas mngal 'tshol bas/ dri za mngal gyi skye gnas 'tshol ba'i dus zhes bya'o// nyams len/ chags sdang snang ba kun spangs la// dran pa'i spyan pas mtshams sbyar te// mngal sgo 'dam pa'i sbyor ba bya// mngon dga'i 'pho ba byas pa yis// gang 'dod gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ zhes pa/ 'jigs skrag sogs snang ba thams cad sgyu mar dran na mngal ngan pa 'gag /stong pa dang*/ bla ma yi dam du dran na mngal ngan pa 'gag /de nas mngal bzang po rigs che zhing mtho ba 'byor pa dang ldan pa/ chos spyod pa'i skal pa yod par bsams bzhin du lus len pa skye ba sprul pa'i sku zhes bya la/ sbyangs pa che bas/ 'od gsal mngon du ma byas kyang*/ dag pa'i zhing bde ba can mngon dga' la sogs par skyes nas phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpar 'gyur ro// drug pa 'pho ba la/ rab chos skur 'pho ba/ 'bring longs sku/ tha ma skye ba 'dzin pa gsum mo/ dang po rab chos skur 'pho ba ni/ bar do dang po la 'od gsal mngon du byas pa de'o// gnyis pa 'bring longs skur 'pho ba ni/ bar dor zung 'jug gi skur bzhengs pa'o// gsum pa tha ma skye ba 'dzin pa la bya'o// de gsum ka 'bras bur bzhag pas/ lam khyer gyi gdams ngag bsgom bya la khyad zhugs ba ma yin pas/ 'dir rnam shes bla ma'i 'pho ba zhes bya ba ston te/ bum pa sngon du brtsams nas ni/ nyi shu rtsa gcig dbugs dag gis// gnas nas drag tu drangs nas su// gzhung tshigs nang yar pad+ma yi// 'khor lo nyi shu rtsa gcig bsam// tshigs gcig nas ni tshigs gcig go /yar ldog mar ldog sa bon gyi// sbyong ba (89)yi ge phyed dang gnyis// nga ro drag tu brjod pa yis// shes pa bde ba can du gtad// dus la bab na 'pho bya ste/

zhes pas/ sbyang ba dang las la sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po sbyang ba ni byang chub tu sems bskyed/ rang rje btsun ma stong rar bsgom/ las kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma khang stong gi ka ba lta bu'o gzum pa/ steng rgya mthongs kha phye ba lta bur bsam pa'i gtsug tu/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang stong ra'i sku'i nang du ye shes kyi rtsa dbu ma dang*/ rang gi gnyis kha sbyar du bsam/ bla ma'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig sngon po dang*/ rang gi snying gar rnam shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig spus bris pa lta bur bsam/ rlung bum pa can bsgom/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi zhabs kyu nar gyis brkyang*/ snying ga'i rnam shes kyi ngo bo la 'khril nas gyen du drangs par bsam/ rlung phyir 'bud pa dang hig gi sgras dbugs thengs gcig la nyer gcig sdangs stabs su bya'o// des hūm̐ spyi bor sleb par bsam/ kas 'thur du phab/ rtags ma byung bar du sbyang*/ gnyis pa las la sbyar ba'i tshe/ bla ma'i thugs kar thim/ bla ma 'og min du gshegs bsam du med pa'i ngang la gzhag go /pu ri byang chub snying po'i spor// mnga' ris gangs dkar gyi lha btsun chen po/ gzhan phan bzang pos bskul nas/ dge slong mkhas pa pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /(90)
